```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 02_frequency_data_viz
title: >
  Data Visualization Reflection
questions:
  - id: data_viz_example
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Submit
    prompt: >
      Can you think of a compelling data visualization you have seen? What did
      it show? How did it help you understand something about the world?
    hint: >
      Maps, news graphics, weather plots, election charts, and sports graphics
      all count. Focus on what the visual form helped you notice, not just the
      topic it was about.
    explanation: >
      Whatever example you chose, it was worth pausing to notice what the visual
      form made easy to see---a comparison, trend, cluster, gap, or location,
      perhaps. As a next step, ask what the same design leaves out or makes
      harder to see. If you drew a blank, or you'd simply like more examples,
      have a look at
      [r/dataisbeautiful](https://www.reddit.com/r/dataisbeautiful/).
```
